messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — for the SOC2 fieldwork tomorrow we need the evidence showing the emergency RBAC change that was applied during the incident on 2025-03-12. Specifically: who requested it, the approval path, the playbook run, and the KMS key usage audit. Can you package that?

maria: Thanks for the heads up. We have the RBAC change logged as a temporary rolebinding edit in k8s; approved via PagerDuty incident workflow. I can grab the change request PR link, PD incident ID, and the k8s audit log slice.

auditor_jane: Great — auditor wants the export as a single artifact if possible (rolebinding diff + approval email + KMS activity). ETA?

maria: I can assemble this by EOD. Quick note: the KMS usage for that window is on the envelope key, not the root key — so the auditor will see Encrypt/Decrypt calls for the envelope key ARN.

kevin: Adding context: the ephemeral key used was created by our rotation lambda with tag "incident-temp:true". We set TTL=1h and invoked it from the ops-runner service account. I can pull the KMS CloudTrail entries.

sre_tom: Also will include the S3 presigned object audit (where the payload snapshot was uploaded). The S3 PutObject and GetObject events are in CloudTrail and in our SIEM for that timeframe.

auditor_jane: Do you have a sample Splunk/SIEM query I can review to validate the extraction?

maria: Yep — here's the quick Splunk query we used to get the RBAC change and KMS activity (paste into Splunk search head):

```
index=infra_logs (k8s_audit OR cloudtrail) ("rolebindings" OR "KMS") earliest="03/12/2025:00:00:00" latest="03/12/2025:04:00:00" | sort _time
```

kevin: And the CloudTrail filter for KMS events:

```
EventName=Encrypt OR EventName=Decrypt OR EventName=GenerateDataKey | ResourceName="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EPHEMERAL-KEY-ID" | lookup user_table userIdentity.arn AS userArn OUTPUT user_email
```

maria: For the RBAC approval chain — the PagerDuty incident contains the approval note (approver=leo@redwood.com) and the on-call exec sign-off. I'll export the incident timeline and attach the PD link.

auditor_jane: We also need evidence that the temporary rolebinding was revoked after the incident and the timeline showing revoke time.

sre_tom: Revoke is in k8s audit: DELETE /apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/rolebindings/<name>. We'll include the full audit chunk with before/after.

kevin: One more compliance ask — can you show the KMS key policy changes (if any) and the key rotation metadata? We didn't change key policy but want to show rotation config.

maria: We didn't modify the key policy during the incident. I'll include the DescribeKey output and rotation status. Example CLI to reproduce: `aws kms describe-key --key-id EPHEMERAL-KEY-ID` and `aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id EPHEMERAL-KEY-ID`

auditor_jane: Perfect. Also asked: are there screenshots or signed attestations we can include that map the playbook run to the runbook owner?

maria: I'll export the runbook execution history from our runbook system (Rundeck) — includes user, start/end timestamps, and a runbook output snippet.

kevin: For packaging, propose: 1) PD incident HTML export 2) k8s audit json slice 3) CloudTrail KMS csv 4) DescribeKey JSON 5) Rundeck run output 6) S3 object metadata + presigned URL hash. Put them in a zip and SHA256 manifest.

auditor_jane: That packaging approach works. Can you flag any redaction needed? We need to avoid sharing full customer payloads in S3 objects — a redacted snapshot is fine.

sre_tom: We'll scrub any PII from the snapshot; include the MD5/SHA checksums and note redactions in a README.

maria: Ok - I'll assemble artifacts and upload to the secure evidence bucket, then share a presigned download link and the manifest in this thread. ETA ~5 hours.

auditor_jane: Thank you — one last question: during the vuln triage earlier that week, was the RBAC change required as mitigation or purely operational? Auditor wants rationale documented in control mapping.

maria: It was mitigation to limit blast radius for a privilege escalation path we were triaging. I'll include the vuln ticket (ISSUE-1122), the triage notes, and the decision log showing the temporary elevation was scoped and timeboxed.

kevin: FYI — I will also attach the post-incident review link and the follow-up remediation plan which includes RBAC hardening and automation to avoid manual role edits.

auditor_jane: This looks thorough. Please @mention me when upload is ready. If possible include a short mapping doc that maps each artifact to the SOC2 control (e.g., CC6.1 / CC7.2 equivalents).

maria: Will do. tagging here when done. :thumbsup:

evidence-bot: Artifact bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/attachments/7081234567-incident-evidence.zip (presigned link valid 7 days)

maria: presigned link and manifest SHA256: 3f5b2d9e... (uploaded). auditor_jane please confirm you can access.

auditor_jane: I can access and the bundle looks good. Thanks for the quick turnaround. We'll review and follow up if anything else is needed.
